figcaption.span: How the prediction works: the window, the block, and the single correction bit

svg.aria-label: A diagram of the causal window the decoder reads, the block whose transform is predicted, and the one bin the encoder spends when the prediction was wrong
svg.text: already reconstructed, already known to both sides
the decoder's prediction, from the window
one bin: was the prediction right?
if it was wrong, two bins pick between the rest
the decoder reads its own window
it predicts the mode, at no cost
right: take the prediction. wrong: read two more
one bitstream, one flag in the header
